def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bar=None;axis=None;bcol=None;br=None

    if bar is None:

            if all(g[r][c]==v for c in range(W)) and v!=bg:
                bar=v;axis='row';br=r;break
    sh=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=bar]
    res=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]

        for r,c,v in sh: res[r][c]=v
        for r in range(H): res[r][bcol]=bar
        sgn=1 if min(c for _,c,_ in sh)>bcol else -1

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bar=None;axis=None;bcol=None;br=None
    for c in range(W):
        v=g[0][c]
        if all(g[r][c]==v for r in range(H)) and v!=bg:
            bar=v;axis='col';bcol=c;break
    if bar is None:
        for r in range(H):
            v=g[r][0]
            if all(g[r][c]==v for c in range(W)) and v!=bg:
                bar=v;axis='row';br=r;break
    sh=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=bar]
    cells={(r,c):g[r][c] for r,c,_ in sh}
    res=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='col':
        for r in range(H): res[r][bcol]=bar
        cs=[c for _,c,_ in sh]
        sgn=1 if min(cs)>bcol else -1
        dc=(bcol+1-min(cs)) if sgn==1 else (bcol-1-max(cs))
        for (r,c),v in cells.items(): res[r][c+dc]=v
        far=(max(c for _,c,_ in sh)+dc) if sgn==1 else (min(c for _,c,_ in sh)+dc)
        c8=far+(1 if sgn==1 else -1)
        for r in range(H): res[r][c8]=8
    else:
        for c in range(W): res[br][c]=bar
        rs=[r for r,_,_ in sh]
        sgn=-1 if max(rs)<br else 1   # shape above bar -> moves down (+1 direction)
        dr=(br-1-max(rs)) if sgn==-1 else (br+1-min(rs))
        for (r,c),v in cells.items(): res[r+dr][c]=v
        fr=(max(r for r,_,_ in sh)+dr) if sgn==-1 else (min(r for r,_,_ in sh)+dr)
        r8=fr+(1 if sgn==-1 else -1)
        for c in range(W): res[r8][c]=8
    return res

from collections import Counter
import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
gi3,go3=G['Demo pair 3 input'],G['Demo pair 3 output']
gi4,go4=G['Demo pair 4 input'],G['Demo pair 4 output']

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bar=None;axis=None;bcol=None;br=None
    for c in range(W):
        v=g[0][c]
        if all(g[r][c]==v for r in range(H)) and v!=bg:
            bar=v;axis='col';bcol=c;break
    if bar is None:
        for r in range(H):
            v=g[r][0]
            if all(g[r][c]==v for c in range(W)) and v!=bg:
                bar=v;axis='row';br=r;break
    sh=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=bar]
    cells={(r,c):g[r][c] for r,c,_ in sh}
    res=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if axis=='col':
        for r in range(H): res[r][bcol]=bar
        side=1 if min(c for _,c,_ in sh)>bcol else -1
        c8=bcol+side
        dc=(c8-1-side*0)  # placeholder
        # slide: new left edge = c8+1 if side==1 else c8-1 (adjacent on bar side)
        target = c8+1 if side==1 else c8-1
        dc=target-min(c for _,c,_ in sh)
        for (r,c),v in cells.items(): res[r][c+dc]=v
        for r in range(H): res[r][c8]=8
    else:
        for c in range(W): res[br][c]=bar
        side=1 if min(r for r,_,_ in sh)>br else -1
        target=br+1 if side==1 else br-1
        dr=target-min(r for r,_,_ in sh)
        for (r,c),v in cells.items(): res[r+dr][c]=v
        for c in range(W): res[br+side][c]=8
    return res
print('demo3', f(gi3)==go3, 'demo4', f(gi4)==go4)
out=f(G['Test input'])
for r in out: print(r)
print(json.dumps(out))
